who_results.title: Hereditary mixed polyposis syndrome (GREM1)
who_results.excerpt: Entity: Hereditary mixed polyposis syndrome (GREM1) definition: Hereditary mixed polyposis syndrome (HMPS) is an autosomal dominant colorectal tumour predisposition syndrome caused by duplications upstream of GREM1, characterized by a mixture of colorectal polyps of different types, including individual polyps with mixed histology, and a predisposition to colorectal adenocarcinoma. related_terminology: Not recommended: Colorectal cancer, susceptibility to, 4 (CRCS4); Colorectal cancer, susceptibility to, on chromosome 15. essential_and_desirable_diagnostic_criteria: Essential: Identification of a duplication affecting GREM1 involving regulatory elements located between SCG5 and GREM1 is essential for diagnosis. who_results.title: Mucinous carcinoma, intestinal type, of the vagina
who_results.entity_name: Mucinous carcinoma, intestinal type, of the vagina
who_results.excerpt: Entity: Mucinous carcinoma, intestinal type, of the vagina definition: Mucinous carcinoma, intestinal type, of the vagina is a primary vaginal adenocarcinoma with features similar or identical to those seen in colorectal carcinomas. related_terminology: Not recommended: cloacogenic adenocarcinoma essential_and_desirable_diagnostic_criteria: Essential: adenocarcinoma with intestinal differentiation. Desirable: goblet cells are usually present but are not required.

who_results.title: AXIN2-associated polyposis (AXIN2)
who_results.excerpt: Entity: AXIN2-associated polyposis (AXIN2) definition: AXIN2-associated polyposis is an autosomal dominant syndrome due to constitutional (germline) loss-of-function variants in AXIN2 and is characterized by multiple colorectal adenomatous polyps, increased risk of colorectal cancer and variable extra-colonic features of oligodontia and ectodermal dysplasia. related_terminology: Acceptable: oligodontia-colorectal cancer syndrome essential_and_desirable_diagnostic_criteria: Essential Familial adenomatous polyposis (5 to >100 polyps) with increased risk of CRC, with or without oligodontia and/or ectodermal dysplasia. Exclusion of constitutional (germline) APC and MUTYH variants Identification of constitutional AXIN2 pathogenic variants See summary table #39035
